people.reason: Appointment of Mr. Rajiv Dube (DIN: 00021796) as an Additional Director (Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director).
people.brief_profile:
Mr. Rajiv Dube is an Indian industry veteran with over 40 years of multi-sector experience, having served at the highest echelons of two Indian conglomerates - Tata and Aditya Birla.
An engineer and a post-graduate in Business Management, he began his career on the shop floor of Tata Motors and rose to be President of its car business before joining the group board of the Aditya Birla group as an executive director, on which he remained for nearly nine years.
people.relationships: Mr. Rajiv Dube is not related to any Director of the Company

people.quote: the Board has also approved her appointment as an Independent Director of the Company for a term of three years commencing from 30th October 2026 up to 29th October 2029
people.reason: Appointment of Ms. Kalpana Merchant (DIN: 00827907) as an Additional Director. Further, the Board also approved her appointment as an Independent Director, for a period of three years, subject to approval of the shareholders.
people.brief_profile:
Ms. Kalpana Merchant has over 45 years of experience in the legal profession. She has significant experience in dealing with the commercial property matters. Her experience also spans diverse practice areas, including infrastructure, project finance and banking, dispute resolution, capital markets, and mergers and acquisitions, including joint ventures.
She has been associated with, and has been a partner at, Kanga & Co., AZB & Partners and Jerome Merchant + Partners. She holds a Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.) degree and a Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in Psychology and is a qualified solicitor.
people.relationships: Ms. Kalpana Merchant is not related to any Director of the Company
